newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - July 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - July 18.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - National Assembly decides not to extend lawmakers' tenure; assembly expected to pass third and final reading of constitutional amendments today (Friday).
Issues of plebiscite, presidential election system to be discussed during next spring's constitutional amendment session.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Government plans large-scale cabinet reshuffle.
Constitutional reforms grant Legislative Yuan (parliament) right to impeach president and vice president.
LIBERTY TIMES - National Assembly expected to complete constitutional amendments.
Stock turnover registers all-time high T$297 billion.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Four major harbours to be managed by private firms.
Many firms show keen interest in investing in new Tainan Science-based Industrial Park.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Taiwan to privatise related transport industries.
Taiwan to set tax for warrant trading on Saturday.
